turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on he, she and it with -s?
turns.tutor:
Sure! I will solve one first and say each step.
I work every day. Omar works every day. Step 1: Omar = he. Step 2: he, she or it means -s. So work becomes works.
Rule: with he, she or it, the verb gets -s.
Right: She cooks dinner. Wrong: She cook dinner.

Your try. Write only the verb:
Write the correct form: My sister ___ (play) tennis on Sundays. (answer with only the verb)
